text:
alex.kim: heads up — alerting that canary group `canary-42` is seeing a 12% 5xx rate and 300ms tail latency increase. automated rollback didn't fire. paging @sam-oncall and @maria.chen :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Paging sam-oncall (on-call). Severity: p1. Incident created: /incidents/1769991234
sam-oncall: on it, grabbing logs. maria if you can pull canary metrics and PR that changed routing rules?
maria.chen: looking — last deploy included a traffic-split tweak + new route table entry. spike aligns w/ that push at 1769989200. sending logs now. :mag:
lisa-nguyen: saw some error bursts in the user-agent filter — `NullPointer` in request parser for requests with header X-Client-Ext. I can try to repro locally with sample header dump.
alex.kim: ok we need to decide rollback vs feature-flag kill-switch. If it's header parsing bug, kill-switch route might be fastest. Can someone check if feature-flag `route_v2` is safe to flip?
jordan-cs: customers are reporting errors for a small subset of tenants. CS is triaging; I have a list of impacted org ids if needed. Notifying key accounts.
sam-oncall: trying the automated rollback webhook logs — looks like the monitor condition was `5xx > 10% for 5m` but the canary was noisy and metric aggregator dropped it below threshold intermittently. The alerting window misaligned, so auto-rollback didn't persist.
maria.chen: confirmed. we have short bursts at 12% but averaged down to 9% in the 5m window. we should do manual rollback/kill-switch.
alex.kim: steps: 1) disable `route_v2` feature-flag to 0% 2) if that doesn't stabilize in 2 min, initiate manual rollback to previous deploy (rev: release-2026-03-15-7). sam please run the kill-switch and post verification commands.
sam-oncall: toggling flag now via LaunchDarkly CLI:
```
ldctl flags update --key route_v2 --env prod --value false
```
Running... :computer:
deploy-bot: feature-flag update succeeded: `route_v2=false` (changed by sam-oncall).
sam-oncall: ok flag flip done. watching metrics — giving it 90s for propagation.
lisa-nguyen: logs show requests dropping to the stable path. 5xx rate trending down to ~3% :thumbsup:
alex.kim: great — continue to monitor for 10m. jordan, let CS know we rolled back the route toggle and are observing stability. prepare postmortem note.
jordan-cs: will do, messaging impacted accounts now.
maria.chen: capturing rollback checklist: `-- verify canary logs cleared`, `-- run smoke on 10 tenants`, `-- ensure kv cache warmed`. I'll run smoke now and post results.
maria.chen: smoke results: 10/10 tenants ok, no 5xx in last 2m. latency back to baseline.
sam-oncall: marking incident as mitigated. I'll follow up with manual rollback plan in case the flag flip regresses: manual rollback command (k8s rollout):
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-runtime inference-runtime=registry/redwood/inference:release-2026-03-15-6
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/inference-runtime
```

alex.kim: good notes. action items: sam — create a short runbook for this sync/metric mismatch. maria — add guard to monitor (persisted 2m above threshold) or expand aggregator window. lisa — PR to harden header parsing. jordan — customer comms. assign owners in pagerduty ticket.
incident-bot: Incident 1769991234 status changed to PARTIALLY_MITIGATED by sam-oncall.
sam-oncall: handing off to maria for long-term follow-up, I'll stay on call until the next 30m check. @maria.chen you own postmortem.
maria.chen: taking lead. will capture timeline, root cause (metric aggregation smoothing + header-edge bug), and recommended changes.
alex.kim: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick work. :heart:
